title: Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning
relation: Established random coefficients, GP conditioning, explicit-basis diffuse-prior intercept; section 2.7

title: Meta-Learning Priors for Efficient Online Bayesian Regression
relation: ALPaCA learns finite-dimensional feature/prior parameters for Bayesian few-shot regression. This candidate does not introduce that family.

title: Learning to learn with Gaussian processes
relation: Task-distance kernel for GP meta-learning; this candidate uses a common contrast covariance rather than a new task kernel.

title: Scalable Meta-Learning with Gaussian Processes
relation: ScaML-GP combines meta-task posterior information; this candidate is a limited finite-rank residual model, not a reproduction of ScaML-GP.

title: Meta-learning to Calibrate Gaussian Processes with Deep Kernels for Regression Uncertainty Estimation
relation: Separate empirical uncertainty calibration is needed; closed-form Bayesian conditioning is not itself a real-data calibration certificate.
